purpose: Prometheus -> Alertmanager -> authenticated Middleware incident ingress. Alertmanager only notifies; Middleware owns incident and control state. One alert fingerprint is one incident; repeated firing notifications never create a second incident.

v3_candidate_observed.authority: informational only; unmerged, owned by the Middleware V3 session

authentication.caller_enforcement: app/observability_alerts.py authorize(): X-Tenant-ID must equal the fixed policy tenant, azp must be alertmanager, scope verified, token subject required

required_headers.X-Tenant-ID: codestra-platform (fixed policy tenant; any other value is 403)
required_headers.X-Correlation-ID: 1..180 chars, required; echoed into the incident timeline
required_headers.Idempotency-Key: 8..180 chars matching ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{7,179}$; stable per notification so a retry replays
required_headers.X-Alertmanager-Webhook: v4 for the native webhook payload (up to 100 alerts); absent for the canonical single-alert envelope

request_bounds.body_bytes_maximum: policy.max_body_bytes (config/observability-alert-policy.v1.json); Content-Length and the streamed body are both bounded before parsing

idempotency_and_dedupe.request_identity: sha256(client_id \n Idempotency-Key \n alert.fingerprint) - an exact replay answers 200 with the stored result
idempotency_and_dedupe.ONE_ALERT_FINGERPRINT_ONE_INCIDENT: PASS (structural: the incident id is a pure function of tenant + fingerprint; repeated firing notifications update the same incident and are reported result=duplicate)
idempotency_and_dedupe.repeat_interval_effect: Alertmanager repeat_interval re-sends firing groups (15m critical .. 12h informational); each re-send is a duplicate delivery, never a new incident

response_codes.207: native batch accepted with explicit per-alert failures
response_codes.400: schema, header or bound violation (not retryable with the same payload)
response_codes.401: authentication failed (rotate the token, then retry)
response_codes.409: idempotency conflict: same key, different payload (not retryable)
response_codes.503: durable dependency unavailable (retry with the same Idempotency-Key)

safe_retry.alertmanager_behaviour: webhook notifier retries on 5xx and network errors with backoff inside group_interval; the same alert group is re-sent unchanged
safe_retry.idempotency_guarantee: a retried delivery carries the same fingerprint set; Middleware answers 200/duplicate instead of creating incidents
safe_retry.correlation: X-Correlation-ID is preserved across retries so the incident timeline shows one delivery chain

mapping.RESOLVED: resolved (alert status=resolved, or POST .../resolve by the operator; reopen returns to firing)

incident_lifecycle.transitions_owned_by: Middleware only; Alertmanager never mutates incident state directly

v3_expectations: The V3 kernel keeps /v1/integrations/alertmanager/events (or publishes a successor under /platform/v1) with the same headers, bounds, idempotency and fingerprint identity
The MiddlewareV3* alerts prepared in Codestra-Prometheus route through the existing severity receivers unchanged
Incident state stays a Middleware projection; Grafana reads it through the Middleware Observability datasource
